title: Artifacts: Docs, Slides, Designs, and Interactive Apps

questions.prompt: Which setting must be on for artifacts to work?
questions.explanation: Artifacts require Code execution and file creation to be turned on in Settings > Capabilities (Organization settings on Team and Enterprise).

questions.prompt: Match each artifact template to what it makes.

pairs.right: Presentations that export to PowerPoint or PDF
Visuals and prototypes on a canvas
Live charts from connected apps and data

questions.explanation: Docs, Slides, and Design are the three templates; Dashboards (beta, paid plans) build charts that show their query and last refresh time.

questions.prompt: When an AI-powered artifact calls Claude, the usage counts against each ____'s own plan limits.
questions.explanation: AI-powered artifacts cost the builder nothing; usage counts against each user's own plan limits.

questions.prompt: Which are valid ways to edit an artifact? Select all that apply.

options.text: Ask for changes in the chat
Edit a doc, slide, or design directly
Highlight a section and use Edit with Claude
Email the artifact to Anthropic for changes

questions.explanation: You can ask in chat, edit directly in templates, or highlight a section and describe the change with Edit with Claude.

questions.prompt: A team tool stores everyone's feedback in shared storage. What's the consequence?

options.text: Everyone who uses the artifact can see all of the stored feedback
Only the builder can see it
The data is deleted after each session
Anthropic reviews it before others see it

questions.explanation: Shared storage is visible to everyone using the artifact; personal storage keeps each user's data private. The builder chooses which to use.

questions.prompt: Order the steps for building and sharing an interactive artifact safely.

items.text: Share it deliberately with the people who need it
Describe the tool you want Claude to build
Decide what goes in personal versus shared storage
Iterate on features and fix issues

questions.explanation: Build it, refine it, settle the storage scope (since shared storage is visible to all users), and only then share it. Artifacts start private.
